title: Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes
title_zh: 将绘画变化图作为生成绘画过程的引导

paragraphs.en: Digital art generation has undergone a massive paradigm shift, moving from static image synthesis to dynamic video generation that can mimic the human painting process. While existing models can synthesize visually stunning time-lapses of paintings being created or ”unpainted,” they largely treat the creative process as a black box. Current conditioning mechanisms are either too rigid, relying on static geometric cues like Canny edges or depth maps, or too holistic, utilizing simple scalar progress variables that offer no localized control. Consequently, users lack the agency to steer how a painting evolves over time. In this work, we argue that true control over the video generation of artwork requires a joint understanding of two fundamental dimensions: where an artist acts, and when those actions take place. To achieve this, we introduce the Painting Change Map, a novel spatio-temporal control mechanism that explicitly tracks normalized structural changes across a 1,000-timestep continuum, a resolution sufficient to capture fine-grained stroke-level changes while remaining computationally tractable. By mapping localized visual differences into an encoded RGB space, our representation enables fine-grained guidance for both the forward painting and reverse unpainting processes. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. We outperform existing control baselines and achieve competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art painting methods. Furthermore, under oracle conditions, our method surpasses all baselines by a significant margin. Code is available at https://github.com/Markus-Pobitzer/painting-change-map .
paragraphs.zh: 数字艺术生成经历了巨大的范式转变，从静态图像合成转向能够模仿人类绘画过程的动态视频生成。 尽管现有模型能够合成视觉上令人惊叹的绘画创作或“反向擦除”的延时画面，但它们在很大程度上将创作过程视为一个黑箱。 当前的条件机制要么过于僵化，依赖于诸如 Canny 边缘或深度图等静态几何线索，要么过于整体化，仅使用无法提供局部控制的简单标量进度变量。 因此，用户缺乏引导绘画随时间演化的能动性。 在本工作中，我们认为要对艺术作品的视频生成实现真正的控制，需要对两个基本维度的联合理解：艺术家在哪里行动，以及这些行动何时发生。 为实现这一目标，我们提出了绘画变化图，这是一种新颖的时空控制机制，能够在 1,000 个时间步的连续体上显式追踪归一化的结构变化，这一分辨率足以捕捉细粒度的笔画级变化，同时保持计算上的可处理性。 通过将局部视觉差异映射到编码的 RGB 空间中，我们的表示方法能够为正向绘画和反向擦除两个过程提供细粒度的引导。 大量的基准测试证明了我们方法的有效性。 我们超越了现有的控制基线，与最先进的绘画方法相比取得了相当或更优的结果。 此外，在 oracle 条件下，我们的方法以显著优势超越了所有基线。 代码可在 https://github.com/Markus-Pobitzer/painting-change-map 获取。

paragraphs.en: The creation of art is as much about the temporal process as it is about the final piece. In our minds, we naturally envision not just what to paint, but how to paint it, sequencing actions, layering backgrounds, and building structure over time. Understanding and directing this chronological evolution is essential for artists to have real control over their work. The same should hold for methods that aim to recreate the painting process. Yet, current methodologies in painting video synthesis generally suffer from an oversimplification of the underlying spatio-temporal manifold, falling into one of three restrictive paradigms.
paragraphs.zh: 艺术创作不仅关乎最终作品，也同样关乎时间性的过程。 在我们的脑海中，我们自然会构想的不仅是画什么，还有如何去画：安排动作的先后顺序、分层铺设背景，并随时间逐步搭建结构。 理解并引导这种按时间顺序的演化，对于艺术家真正掌控自己的作品至关重要。 对于旨在重现绘画过程的方法而言，情况也应如此。 然而，当前绘画视频合成的方法普遍存在对底层时空流形过度简化的问题，往往落入三种受限范式中的一种。

paragraphs.en: Instance Level Optimization: Frameworks like Inverse Painting [ 7 ] operate on the assumption that a painting video can be decomposed into an isolated sequence of object-level masks (e.g., sky, mountains). This approach fails in the presence of global artistic techniques, such as multi-instance underpainting, where initial background layers cross object boundaries. Furthermore, its selection mechanism is purely reactive, applying masked inpainting until the mathematical distance to the final image is sufficiently minimized, meaning it possesses no concept of layered composition or user intent.
paragraphs.zh: 实例级优化：诸如 Inverse Painting [7] 之类的框架基于这样一个假设：绘画视频可以被分解为一系列彼此隔离的对象级掩码序列（例如天空、山脉）。 这种方法在存在全局性艺术技法时会失效，例如多实例底层铺色，其初始背景层会跨越物体边界。 此外，其选择机制是纯被动的，仅通过反复应用掩码修复，直到与最终图像的数学距离被充分最小化为止，这意味着它不具备分层构图或用户意图的概念。

paragraphs.en: Progress Based Conditioning: State-of-the-art models like Paints Undo [ 21 ] and Paints Alter [ 28 ] track artwork progression via a singular, global scalar variable. While this allows for coarse backward and forward generation, a 1D scalar cannot capture spatial variance. An artist may completely finish a background element (100% progress locally) while keeping a foreground subject as a raw sketch (0% progress locally). Relying entirely on text prompts to fill this spatial steering gap yields highly unpredictable results unless dense reference frames are provided continuously.
paragraphs.zh: 基于进度的条件控制：Paints Undo [ 21 ] 和 Paints Alter [ 28 ] 等最先进的模型通过单一的、全局的标量变量来追踪绘画作品的进度。 虽然这可以实现粗糙的正向与反向生成，但一维标量无法捕捉空间上的差异。 艺术家可能已经完全完成某个背景元素（局部进度为 100%），而前景主体仍停留在原始草图阶段（局部进度为 0%）。 如果不持续提供密集的参考帧，仅依靠文本提示来填补这一空间引导上的空缺，会产生极难预测的结果。

paragraphs.en: Fixed Linear Interpolation: Architectures like Loomis Painter [ 17 ] completely omit temporal conditioning inputs. The model implicitly learns a linear progression since the number of frames to generate stayed consistent. This rigid architectural design completely strips away temporal flexibility, making it impossible to adjust the pacing, or order of the generated actions.
paragraphs.zh: 固定线性插值：像 Loomis Painter [ 17 ] 这类架构完全省略了时间条件输入。 由于需要生成的帧数保持一致，模型隐式地学习到了一种线性推进方式。 这种僵化的架构设计完全剥夺了时间上的灵活性，使得无法调整生成动作的节奏或顺序。

paragraphs.en: In this work we want to address the introduced shortcomings by explicitly grounding the painting video generation task on a fine grained control map that abstracts the painting process as a joint encoding of spatial location and temporal buildup, without considering the stroke color and its physical interaction with the canvas or underlying color, such as color mixing or drying. With the help of such a control mechanism the training data can also be used more efficiently. More importantly the painting process can be viewed in a very detailed manner, coming close to a stroke level generation. Our contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We introduce the Painting Change Map (PCM), a novel spatio-temporal representation that jointly encodes the spatial location and chronological sequence of a painting process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了绘画变化图（Painting Change Map, PCM），这是一种新颖的时空表示方法，能够联合编码绘画过程的空间位置和时间先后顺序。

paragraphs.en: We propose the Interpolation & Lineart encoding strategy to seamlessly integrate the PCM into standard RGB video diffusion control videos. At the same time, we show three alternatives, including grayscale interpolation, 24-bit packaging, and historical channel tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出插值与线性（Interpolation & Lineart）编码策略，将 PCM 无缝集成到标准 RGB 视频扩散控制视频中。 同时，我们展示了三种替代方案，包括灰度插值、24 位打包和历史通道追踪。

sents.en: We propose the Interpolation & Lineart encoding strategy to seamlessly integrate the PCM into standard RGB video diffusion control videos.
sents.zh: 我们提出插值与线性（Interpolation & Lineart）编码策略，将 PCM 无缝集成到标准 RGB 视频扩散控制视频中。

sents.en: At the same time, we show three alternatives, including grayscale interpolation, 24-bit packaging, and historical channel tracking.
sents.zh: 同时，我们展示了三种替代方案，包括灰度插值、24 位打包和历史通道追踪。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that the PCM-based control mechanism can be generated and subsequently used to recreate the creation process of a painting. This two-stage pipeline first allows the model to focus exclusively on the structural painting process, and in the second stage, generates the actual color-based rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了基于 PCM 的控制机制可以被生成，并随后用于重现一幅绘画的创作过程。 这一两阶段流水线首先使模型能够专注于结构性的绘画过程，然后在第二阶段生成实际的基于颜色的渲染。

sents.en: We demonstrate that the PCM-based control mechanism can be generated and subsequently used to recreate the creation process of a painting.
sents.zh: 我们证明了基于 PCM 的控制机制可以被生成，并随后用于重现一幅绘画的创作过程。

sents.en: This two-stage pipeline first allows the model to focus exclusively on the structural painting process, and in the second stage, generates the actual color-based rendering.
sents.zh: 这一两阶段流水线首先使模型能够专注于结构性的绘画过程，然后在第二阶段生成实际的基于颜色的渲染。

paragraphs.en: We provide a comprehensive benchmark comparing our method against generic spatial controls (Canny Edges, Depth) and specialized painting architectures (Paints Undo, Loomis Painter), demonstrating superior localized steering capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了一个全面的基准测试，将我们的方法与通用空间控制方法（Canny 边缘、深度图）以及专门的绘画架构（Paints Undo、Loomis Painter）进行比较，展示了更优的局部引导能力。

paragraphs.en: Painting process generation. Several works have looked at synthesizing the painting process of an input images. Neural painting reconstructs this process through stroke sequences inferred by neural networks [ 13 , 14 ] . Models, like Paint Transformer [ 16 ] , use Transformer architectures [ 23 , 9 ] to generate stroke parameters. Later methods use diffusion-based neural networks [ 8 , 19 , 11 ] .

paragraphs.en: While neural painting models may diverge from real painting processes, pixel-based methods overcome this limitation by synthesizing temporally coherent sequences directly at the pixel level. It has been shown that convolutional approaches [ 29 ] can reconstruct simple workflows, whereas Inverse Painting [ 7 ] iteratively masks the next painting area and inpaints it with a diffusion model.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管神经绘画模型可能与真实绘画过程有所偏离，基于像素的方法通过直接在像素层面合成时间上连贯的序列克服了这一局限。 已有研究表明，卷积方法 [29] 可以重建简单的工作流程，而 Inverse Painting [7] 则迭代地遮蔽下一个绘画区域并用扩散模型对其进行补全。

sents.en: It has been shown that convolutional approaches [ 29 ] can reconstruct simple workflows, whereas Inverse Painting [ 7 ] iteratively masks the next painting area and inpaints it with a diffusion model.

paragraphs.en: Recent diffusion-based models improve on these works. ProcessPainter [ 20 ] generates several steps of the painting process as a single image. PaintsUndo [ 21 ] leverages Stable Diffusion [ 18 ] to recreate digital art workflows. Continuing this idea, PaintsAlter [ 28 ] uses a similar idea to adapt a video diffusion model for the task. Loomis Painter [ 17 ] shows that video diffusion models are well adapted for the task by generating the inverse painting process.
paragraphs.zh: 近来基于扩散模型的方法在这些工作基础上有所改进。 ProcessPainter [ 20 ] 将绘画过程的若干步骤生成在单张图像中。 PaintsUndo [ 21 ] 利用 Stable Diffusion [ 18 ] 来重现数字艺术创作流程。 延续这一思路，PaintsAlter [ 28 ] 采用类似的想法，将视频扩散模型适配到该任务上。 Loomis Painter [ 17 ] 通过生成逆向绘画过程，表明视频扩散模型非常适合该任务。

sents.zh: 近来基于扩散模型的方法在这些工作基础上有所改进。

paragraphs.en: Despite producing realistic workflows, these existing approaches lack mechanisms to actively guide the generation steps. Our work addresses this gap by introducing PCM, an explicit spatio-temporal control mechanism that directly guides where and when the model generates.

paragraphs.en: Controlling video generation. Recent painting process generation models use video generation models like LTX [ 10 ] or Wan [ 24 ] . Normally they come in several versions, text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video. PaintsAlter used a video-to-video approach whereas Loomis Painter used an image-to-video approach. For frame level controlled video generation, models normally use a video-to-video approach like in VACE [ 15 ] or VideoX-Fun [ 1 ] . For the control maps, several modalities can be used. Some of the most common ones, already found in image generation control mechanisms like ControlNet [ 27 ] , include: Canny Edges [ 4 ] , Depth Maps, Normal Maps, and semantic maps. The same mechanisms that have to be shown to work well for image generation can also be used for the video generation models as shown by VideoX-Fun. This enables a pixel level control over the generated frames.
paragraphs.zh: 控制视频生成。 最近的绘画过程生成模型使用像 LTX [ 10 ] 或 Wan [ 24 ] 这样的视频生成模型。 通常它们有多个版本，即文生视频、图生视频和视频到视频。 PaintsAlter 采用视频到视频的方法，而 Loomis Painter 采用图生视频的方法。 对于帧级控制的视频生成，模型通常采用视频到视频的方法，如 VACE [ 15 ] 或 VideoX-Fun [ 1 ] 。 对于控制图，可以使用多种模态。 其中一些最常见的模态已经在 ControlNet [ 27 ] 等图像生成控制机制中出现，包括：Canny 边缘 [ 4 ] 、深度图、法线图和语义图。 那些已被证明在图像生成中行之有效的机制，也可以像 VideoX-Fun 所展示的那样用于视频生成模型。 这实现了对生成帧的像素级控制。

paragraphs.en: The central objective of our framework is to construct a robust control mechanism tailored to the temporal and spatial dynamics of the painting process. Traditional structural guidance methods, such as Canny edges [ 4 ] or Lineart [ 6 ] , rely strictly on static feature extraction (e.g., contours and boundaries) to guide generative models. While effective for general image synthesis, these representations do not contain any stroke related information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们框架的核心目标是构建一个针对绘画过程时空动态的鲁棒控制机制。 传统的结构引导方法，如 Canny 边缘 [ 4 ] 或 Lineart [ 6 ]，严格依赖静态特征提取（如轮廓和边界）来引导生成模型。 虽然这些表示对一般图像合成是有效的，但它们不包含任何与笔画相关的信息。

paragraphs.en: When executing a painting using traditional media (e.g., oil or acrylic), an artist progressively deposits layers of pigment onto a canvas over time. The final output is an accumulation of interrelated variables: the medium’s viscosity, structural underpaintings, and individual tool dynamics. Rather than explicitly modeling complex micro-level physical stroke interactions, which we offload to the capacity of our generative backbone, we abstract the painting process as a joint spatiotemporal mapping. This mapping captures exactly where and when geometric changes occur on the canvas.
paragraphs.zh: 当使用传统媒介（如油画颜料或丙烯颜料）进行绘画时，画家会随着时间推移逐步将颜料层层沉积到画布上。 最终输出是多个相互关联变量的累积结果：媒介的黏度、结构性的底层画以及单个工具的动态特性。 我们没有显式建模复杂的微观层面笔触物理交互，而是将绘画过程抽象为一个联合时空映射，把这部分工作交由我们生成式骨干网络的能力来承担。 该映射精确捕捉了几何变化在画布上发生的位置与时机。

paragraphs.en: We formally represent the progression of a painting as a sequence of video frames 𝒱 = { I 1 , I 2 , … , I N } \mathcal{V}=\{I_{1},I_{2},\dots,I_{N}\} , where each frame I t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] C × H × W I_{t}\in[0,1]^{C\times H\times W} . Our framework accommodates both forward-chronological progression and reverse-chronological order (i.e., the “un-painting” sequence starting from a completed artwork down to a blank canvas). paragraphs.en: Real-world painting videos introduce physical artifacts that degrade pixel-level delta consistency. Specifically, physical interactions with the canvas cause displacements or camera tremors. This introduces two main types of errors: spatial misalignment over extended periods, and false-positive change detections across the entire frame.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界的绘画视频会引入物理伪影，从而降低像素级差分一致性。 具体而言，与画布的物理交互会导致位移或相机抖动。 这引入了两大类错误：长时间跨度上的空间错位，以及跨整个画面的误报变化检测。

paragraphs.en: Interpolation & Lineart. While pure change maps successfully isolate dynamic events, static structural boundaries remain crucial for stabilizing the control mechanism. Because fine edges are not always detectable from the change maps alone, and given the aforementioned canvas shifts, explicit edge guidance is necessary to reliably anchor the generative model. To address this, we introduce a hybrid approach termed Interpolation & Lineart .
paragraphs.zh: 插值与线稿。 虽然纯变化图能够成功分离出动态事件，但静态结构边界对于稳定控制机制仍然至关重要。 由于仅凭变化图并不总能检测到精细边缘，加之存在前文所述的画布偏移，因此需要显式的边缘引导来可靠地锚定生成模型。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为「插值与线稿」的混合方法。

sents.en: To address this, we introduce a hybrid approach termed Interpolation & Lineart .
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为「插值与线稿」的混合方法。

paragraphs.en: First, we linearly interpolate between two reference boundary colors ( C start C_{\text{start}} and C end C_{\text{end}} ) conditioned on the temporal value:
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们基于时间值在两个参考边界颜色（C start C_{\text{start}} 和 C end C_{\text{end}}）之间进行线性插值：

paragraphs.en: Setting C start C_{\text{start}} to black and C end C_{\text{end}} to white produces a grayscale representation structurally reminiscent of dense depth maps, where brighter values denote more recent artistic interventions. Next, we compute the structural outlines of the targeted frame using a Lineart extractor [ 6 ] . Finally, the linear interpolation is fused with the structural data by replacing the green and blue (GB) channels with the extracted lineart, yielding a comprehensive spatiotemporal control signal.
paragraphs.zh: 将起始颜色 C_{\text{start}} 设为黑色、结束颜色 C_{\text{end}} 设为白色，可得到一种在结构上让人联想到稠密深度图的灰度表示，其中较亮的数值表示较新的艺术干预。 接下来，我们使用 Lineart 提取器 [ 6 ] 计算目标帧的结构轮廓。 最后，通过用提取的线稿替换绿色和蓝色（GB）通道，将线性插值与结构数据融合，从而得到一个综合的时空控制信号。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed framework, we extend the dataset from Loomis Painter [ 17 ] by linearly sampling 1,000 frames from each video. paragraphs.en: We evaluate our Painting Change Map (PCM) by fine-tuning a Video-to-Video generation model via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 12 ] . The model is conditioned on a control video (the change map) and the final completed artwork to synthesize the intermediate painting steps. Specifically, we employ WAN 2.1 Fun [ 1 ] , an architecture built upon the WAN 2.1 [ 24 ] video generation foundation model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过低秩适配（LoRA）[ 12 ] 对一个视频到视频生成模型进行微调，以此评估我们的绘画变化图（PCM）。 该模型以控制视频（变化图）和最终完成的画作作为条件，来合成中间的绘画步骤。 具体而言，我们采用 WAN 2.1 Fun [ 1 ]，这是一种构建于 WAN 2.1 [ 24 ] 视频生成基础模型之上的架构。

paragraphs.en: Our dataset is the acrylic painting subset consisting of 132 training, 16 test, and 13 validation videos. All results are evaluated on the test split. All variants are trained for 19 epochs on a single NVIDIA A100 (64 GB) GPU, which equates to approximately 8 hours of training per configuration. We use a learning rate of 1e-4. Following the generation paradigm established by Loomis Painter, the synthesis operates in reverse-chronological order (i.e., “un-painting” from the finished motive back to a blank state). Consistent with the underlying base model, our method is trained to generate sequences of 81 frames. To enforce temporal robustness, these sequences are randomly sampled from the 1,000 available video frames during training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据集是丙烯画子集，包含 132 个训练视频、16 个测试视频和 13 个验证视频。 所有结果均在测试集上评估。 所有变体均在单块 NVIDIA A100（64 GB）GPU 上训练 19 个 epoch，每种配置约相当于 8 小时的训练时间。 我们使用 1e-4 的学习率。 遵循 Loomis Painter 所确立的生成范式，合成按时间倒序进行（即从完成的主题“反绘”回空白状态）。 与底层基础模型保持一致，我们的方法被训练用于生成 81 帧的序列。 为了增强时间鲁棒性，这些序列在训练期间从可用的 1,000 个视频帧中随机采样。

paragraphs.en: Depth-Anything-v2 [ 26 ] : A robust depth estimation model. The generation pipeline is conditioned on the estimated depth map corresponding to each target frame.
paragraphs.zh: Depth-Anything-v2 [ 26 ]：一个鲁棒的深度估计模型。 该生成流程以每个目标帧所对应的估计深度图为条件。

paragraphs.en: First, because our generation paradigm conditions the network on the final completed painting, outlines provide a strong structural prior for cross-frame alignment when reversing the painting sequence. Second, as detailed in Sec. 3.2 , movements of the physical camera or canvas introduce spatial drift over time. Ground-truth structural baselines implicitly correct for these shifts by offering fixed geometric anchors in every frame. In contrast, pure temporal change maps isolate localized stroke updates; without explicit static structures, the model struggles to infer global motion from isolated stroke trajectories alone.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，由于我们的生成范式以最终完成的画作为条件来约束网络，在逆向绘制序列时，轮廓能为跨帧对齐提供强有力的结构先验。 其次，如第3.2节所述，物理相机或画布的运动会随时间引入空间漂移。 真值结构基线通过在每一帧中提供固定的几何锚点，隐式地校正了这些偏移。 相比之下，纯时序变化图只隔离局部的笔画更新；缺乏显式的静态结构，模型难以仅凭孤立的笔画轨迹推断全局运动。

paragraphs.en: By explicitly addressing this limitation, our combined approach Interpolation & Lineart bridges both paradigms. By leveraging the stroke progression and the stability of static Lineart, this variant registers substantial performance gains, outperforming all baselines and establishing a new state-of-the-art across every evaluated metric (notably reducing MSE from 592.81 to 449.68).
paragraphs.zh: 通过明确解决这一局限，我们的组合方法插值与线稿（Interpolation & Lineart）桥接了这两种范式。 通过利用笔画的渐进性以及静态线稿（Lineart）的稳定性，该变体取得了显著的性能提升，在所有评估指标上均优于所有基线方法，创造了新的最先进水平（ notably 将 MSE 从 592.81 降至 449.68）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the versatility beyond global unpainting, we investigate our framework’s capacity for fine-grained localized control. This represents a zero-shot scenario, as it diverges from our training strategy. Specifically, we isolate distinct semantic instances (e.g., trees, lakes, mountains) and task the model with unpainting only the targeted region while preserving the static background. Our evaluation spans seven distinct instance categories, conditionally sampled based on their presence within each source painting.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估超越全局去涂抹的多样性，我们研究了本框架在细粒度局部控制方面的能力。 这代表了一个零样本场景，因为它偏离了我们的训练策略。 具体而言，我们分离出不同的语义实例（例如树木、湖泊、山脉），并让模型仅对目标区域进行去涂抹，同时保持静态背景不变。 我们的评估涵盖七个不同的实例类别，并根据每个源画作中是否出现这些类别进行条件采样。

paragraphs.en: The fidelity of our PCM relies on two hyperparameters: the localized spatial sensitivity threshold τ \tau , which separates intentional brushstrokes from sensor noise and minor illumination shifts, and the global motion filtering threshold θ \theta , which isolates camera tremors and canvas displacements. To assess the downstream impact of these hyperparameter configurations on generative performance, we conduct a grid-search ablation study using the Interpolation & Lineart modality as our baseline. Quantitative results across semantic and perceptual metrics are detailed in Tab. 2 .

paragraphs.en: Our analysis reveals that performance is highly robust across a reasonable operational window, yet sensitive at extreme values. Setting a low sensitivity threshold ( τ = 0.05 \tau=0.05 ) forces the model to register ambient noise and compression artifacts as valid changes. This introduces spurious artifacts into the cumulative temporal tensor, leading to degraded perceptual metrics (e.g., LPIPS increases to 0.214 0.214 and MSE rises sharply to 494.96 494.96 ). Conversely, over-filtering with a high threshold ( τ = 0.18 \tau=0.18 ) aggressively strips away genuine, fine-grained stroke actions, causing a subtle drop in semantic metrics like CLIP and DINOv2 as the downstream model loses temporal context. The configuration of τ = 0.13 \tau=0.13 consistently emerges as the optimal point.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析表明，性能在合理的操作窗口内高度稳健，但在极端取值时较为敏感。 设置较低灵敏度阈值（τ = 0.05）会迫使模型把环境噪声和压缩伪影登记为有效变化。 这会在累积时间张量中引入虚假伪影，导致感知指标下降（例如 LPIPS 升至 0.214，MSE 骤升至 494.96）。 相反，使用过高阈值（τ = 0.18）进行过度过滤会激进地剔除真实、细粒度的笔画动作，由于下游模型丢失时间上下文，导致 CLIP 和 DINOv2 等语义指标出现轻微下降。 τ = 0.13 的配置始终是最优选择。

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate the broader utility and generalizability of our control mechanism, we evaluate our framework against state of the art approaches for painting process reconstruction. Unlike the oracle evaluations in previous sections, recreating target painting requires generating its corresponding control signals from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证明我们的控制机制具有更广泛的实用性和通用性，我们将我们的框架与用于绘画过程重建的最先进方法进行了评估。 与前几节中的预言式评估不同，重建目标绘画需要从零开始生成其对应的控制信号。

paragraphs.en: To achieve this, we propose a decoupled, two-stage inference pipeline. In the first stage, we fine-tune a Wan2.1 Image-to-Video (I2V) 5B model [ 24 ] to predict the change maps. Given a painting, this model synthesizes an 81-frame sequence of corresponding Interpolation & Lineart change maps. In the second stage, these generated maps serve as the conditioning signal for our previously trained 1.3B Video-to-Video generation model to synthesize the final unpainting sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现这一目标，我们提出了一种解耦的两阶段推理流水线。 在第一阶段，我们对 Wan2.1 图像到视频（I2V）5B 模型 [ 24 ] 进行微调，以预测变化图。 给定一幅画作，该模型会合成包含 81 帧的对应插值与线稿变化图序列。 在第二阶段，这些生成的变化图作为条件信号，输入我们此前训练的 1.3B 视频到视频生成模型，以合成最终的去绘制序列。

paragraphs.en: Our full generative pipeline generalizes well to unseen artwork, nearly tying the leading baseline, Loomis Painter, in semantic consistency (0.87 vs. 0.88 CLIP) and perceptual fidelity (0.45 vs. 0.44 LPIPS), while strictly outperforming it in structural pixel accuracy (3127.13 vs. 3152.96 MSE). Crucially, while Loomis Painter deterministically samples the same 81 uniformly spaced frames during training, our randomized sampling strategy spans all 1,000 available video frames. This prevents dataset underutilization and inherently improves temporal robustness. Furthermore, our oracle variant ( † \dagger ) outperforms all existing baselines by a substantial margin across every metric, highlighting an exceptionally high performance upper bound as predictive backbones mature.
paragraphs.zh: 我们完整的生成式流水线在未见过的艺术作品上泛化良好，在语义一致性上几乎追平领先的基线方法 Loomis Painter（CLIP 得分 0.87 对 0.88），在感知保真度上也是如此（LPIPS 得分 0.45 对 0.44），同时在结构像素精度上严格超越它（MSE 得分 3127.13 对 3152.96）。 至关重要的是，Loomis Painter 在训练过程中确定性地采样相同的 81 个均匀间隔帧，而我们的随机采样策略覆盖了全部 1,000 个可用视频帧。 这避免了数据集利用不足，并从本质上提升了时序鲁棒性。 此外，我们的 oracle 变体（† \dagger）在所有指标上都大幅超越现有全部基线方法，凸显出随着预测骨干网络的成熟而具备的极高性能上限。

paragraphs.en: Beyond synthesis quality, our decoupled framework offers a significant latency advantage over heavy architectures. By more than tripling the throughput to 0.62 FPS compared to Loomis Painter’s 14B model, our approach proves highly efficient. Because our components execute sequentially rather than concurrently, the memory footprints do not stack. The peak hardware requirement is strictly isolated to 25.84 GB of VRAM during the first stage, dropping to 17.04 GB of VRAM during the second stage. This low memory overhead makes our framework highly accessible for standard mid-tier hardware configurations and renders the pipeline trivially parallelizable. All experiments were conducted on a single NVIDIA A100 SXM4 64GB.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented a novel framework for controllable painting video synthesis that decouples abstract painting actions from the complex physical properties of traditional media. By shifting the generative focus away from modeling intricate interactions like color mixing, paint viscosity, and canvas textures, our framework isolates the core spatiotemporal progression of individual brushstrokes. Through the introduction of the Painting Change Map (PCM) and a decoupled, two-stage inference pipeline, our approach achieves strong evaluation results across both global unpainting benchmarks and localized instance-level control tasks, establishing a high performance upper bound.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种用于可控绘画视频合成的新型框架，该框架将抽象绘画动作与传统媒介的复杂物理属性解耦。 通过将生成重心从建模颜色混合、颜料粘度和画布纹理等复杂交互中转移开来，我们的框架隔离出单个笔触的核心时空推进过程。 通过引入绘画变化图（Painting Change Map, PCM）以及解耦的两阶段推理流水线，我们的方法在全局反绘画基准和局部实例级控制任务上均取得了出色的评估结果，确立了较高的性能上限。

paragraphs.en: A central finding of our study is the critical importance of structural outlines when guiding the generation process. For video material captured from real world painting processes, minor canvas displacements and camera tremors are structurally inevitable. While isolated strokes capture localized actions, they struggle to infer global trajectories amidst these shifts. Fusing temporal progression with explicit lineart boundaries acts as a vital geometric anchor, enabling the diffusion model to maintain cross-frame alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究的一个核心发现是，结构轮廓在引导生成过程中具有至关重要的作用。 对于从真实世界绘画过程中拍摄的视频素材，画布的轻微位移和相机的抖动在结构上是不可避免的。 虽然孤立的笔画能够捕捉局部动作，但在这些偏移之中，它们难以推断全局轨迹。 将时间推进与显式的线稿边界融合，可作为关键的几何锚点，使扩散模型能够保持跨帧对齐。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work. The primary limitations of our approach stem directly from the characteristics of the source dataset. Despite implementing global motion filtering, physical canvas movements mean that strokes painted in the past can gradually lose synchronization and desynchronize from the current frame geometry over extended periods. While this issue would be entirely absent in ideal, perfectly stabilized data, real-world conditions necessitate explicit tracking. Consequently, an promising direction for future work is to integrate automated canvas alignment or keypoint rectification modules into the data pipeline to proactively eliminate spatial drift.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 我们方法的主要局限性直接源于源数据集的特性。 尽管实现了全局运动滤波，但画布的物理移动意味着过去绘制的笔画会逐渐失去同步，并在较长一段时间后与当前帧几何脱节。 虽然这一问题在理想且完美稳定的数据中完全不会出现，但现实条件使得显式跟踪成为必要。 因此，未来工作的一个有前景的方向是将自动画布对齐或关键点矫正模块集成到数据管线中，以主动消除空间漂移。

paragraphs.en: Pure change maps highlight dynamic events rather than static edge boundaries. To integrate both paradigms, we compute structural outlines of the targeted frame using a Lineart extractor [ 6 ] . As the base map we use the Interpolation mode introduced above and replace the last two channels (GB) with the edge maps extracted by the Lineart model.
paragraphs.zh: 纯变化图突出的是动态事件，而非静态的边缘边界。 为了整合这两种范式，我们使用 Lineart 提取器 [6] 计算目标帧的结构轮廓。 作为基础图，我们使用上文介绍的插值模式，并将其最后两个通道（GB）替换为由 Lineart 模型提取的边缘图。
